form_factors.name: web-app-browser
form_factors.rationale: SfcCalculatorPage.tsx + SpeedFeedPage.tsx already scaffold in mcp-server/web. Stack (React+Vite) is canonical 'merged'. Fastest acquisition surface — Stripe checkout + free-tier gating only net-new work. Competitor parity (G-Wizard $70/yr) is browser-first.

form_factors.name: api-only-shop-integration
form_factors.rationale: Dispatcher actions already exist (prism_calc:speedfeed_*). Wrap with API-key auth + per-request quota meter — no UI work. Sells into Shop/Enterprise tier at premium. Reuses tier-gate dispatcher built for web.

form_factors.name: cam-plugin-fusion360
form_factors.rationale: Fusion 360 add-in (Python/JS) calls existing API. Highest conversion (in-workflow context = no copy/paste). Defer to MS1 — needs web/API stable first, plus Autodesk App Store review cycle (~2 weeks).

form_factors.name: cam-plugin-mastercam-chook
form_factors.rationale: C-Hook (C++) higher cost-to-build than Fusion add-in; Mastercam's NetHook (C#) is cheaper. Defer to MS2 — JM Die is Mastercam shop so eventually mandatory, but not first revenue.

form_factors.name: cam-plugin-hypermill-tbc
form_factors.rationale: hyperMILL has Technology Database Connector (TBC) for parameter feed. PRISM already has hyperMILL bridge engines (hypermill-material-lookup, hypermill-speeds-feeds skills). Defer to MS2 after Fusion proves plugin economics.

form_factors.name: mobile-pwa-operator
form_factors.rationale: Defer. Operators-at-machine workflow is real (phone-sized lookup at console) but addressable via PWA install of web app — no native build needed. Add responsive breakpoints to web UI in MS1, formal PWA manifest in MS2.

trial_to_paid_path: Free tier = 3 calcs/day, P-steel only, watermarked CSV, last-5-recipes — enough to demo value (Vc/n/fz are correct, not crippled) but quota hits within first session for any real user. Upgrade modal triggers on (a) 4th calc of day, (b) non-P material selection, (c) Optimize mode click, (d) Compare-3up click, (e) 6th save-recipe. Stripe Checkout one-click to Hobbyist ($9) or Pro ($39). 14-day Pro trial offered on first quota-hit (credit card required to prevent abuse — competitor G-Wizard does free-trial-no-CC and gets gamed). Annual discount 20% (Hobbyist $86/yr vs $108, Pro $375/yr vs $468) shown at checkout.
recommended_first_merge_rationale: Neither pending merge (cqask/ui Next13+AntD, mcp-cadquery Vite+R19) blocks SFC. SfcCalculatorPage.tsx + SpeedFeedPage.tsx already exist in canonical mcp-server/web on React+Vite — that's where U-REV-CAD-SFC-01..06 land. cqask is for CAD-from-LLM (different product, REVENUE-MS1 'AI CAD' bucket) — port to /apps/cad/ subroute post-revenue. mcp-cadquery is a 3D viewer (React 19 mismatch with main React 18) — only relevant if SFC adds part-preview, which is Stretch/P2. RECOMMEND: ship SFC on existing main-web stack (build-fresh on top of existing scaffold, NOT merge pending frontends). Saves 1-2 weeks of React-version-align + routing-merge work that delivers zero SFC revenue.

summary.verdict: GO — ship web+API in 3 weeks on existing main-web stack; defer CAM plugins to MS1+; ignore both pending frontend merges for SFC path.
summary.one_line: Week 1: unstub U-REV-CAD-SFC-01..06 + Stripe + tier-gate dispatcher; Week 2: API-key auth + quota meter + Compare-3up; Week 3: billing portal + upgrade modals + soft launch to JM Die + 5 beta shops; CAM plugins MS1 (weeks 4-8).

weeks_breakdown.week_1: U-REV-CAD-SFC-01..06 UI-unstub (existing SfcCalculatorPage scaffolded), Stripe Checkout + Customer Portal wiring, tier-gate dispatcher (prism_auth:check_quota), free-tier quota meter (Redis counter, daily reset).
weeks_breakdown.week_2: API-key auth surface (prism_auth:create_api_key + middleware), per-request quota for API tier, /sfc/compare 3-up page (parallel orchestrate calls), upgrade-modal triggers (5 placements above).
weeks_breakdown.week_3: /account/billing page (Stripe portal embed), invoice history, team-seats manager for Shop tier, watermarked-CSV export for free, JM Die beta deploy + 5 external beta shops onboarded at Pro tier free for 60 days (data collection).

summary.revenue_model_validation: Pricing anchored against G-Wizard ($70/yr personal = $5.83/mo) — PRISM Hobbyist $9/mo is 54% premium justified by Optimize mode + multi-ISO + Pc/Fc/Tc/δ outputs (G-Wizard only gives Vc/n/fz). Pro $39/mo is 5x premium justified by Compare-3up + stability lobes (G-Wizard has no comparable). Shop $249/mo (~$25/seat at 10 seats) competitive with Sandvik CoroPlus seat license (~$30/seat/mo bundled). Enterprise $999/mo floor matches Kennametal NOVO Enterprise tier.
summary.kill_criteria: If week-3 soft-launch yields <5 paying conversions from beta cohort of 5 shops + JM Die internal seats by week 6, kill SFC-as-standalone-revenue and bundle into PRISM platform tier instead. Indicator: NPS < 30 from beta shops = product-market-fit miss.
